standard-dialogue-speaking-to-the-city-g.speaker: City Guard
standard-dialogue-speaking-to-the-city-g.text: Grrrr, what business have you here ?

standard-dialogue-speaking-to-the-city-g.speaker: City Guard
standard-dialogue-speaking-to-the-city-g.text: So what do you want with me ?

options.text: I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!

steps.player: I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: I would like to see you try!

options.text: I seek passage into the skavid caves

steps.player: I seek passage into the skavid caves

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: You humour me small thing, answer this riddle and I will help you... I want you to bring me an item

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: I will give you all the letters of this item, you work out what it is...

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: My first is in days, but not in years.  My second is in evil, and also in tears. My third is in all, but not in none

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: My fourth is in hot, but not in sun. My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate. My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate.

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: My seventh is in plush, but not in place. My eighth is in nine, but not in eight. My last is in earth, and also in in great

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: My whole is an object, that magic will make. It brings wrack and ruin to all in it's wake...

steps.speaker: City Guard
steps.text: Now how long I wonder, will this riddle take?

standard-dialogue-using-the-death-rune-o.speaker: City Guard
standard-dialogue-using-the-death-rune-o.text: Well well.. the imp has done it!

standard-dialogue-using-the-death-rune-o.speaker: City Guard
standard-dialogue-using-the-death-rune-o.text: This is what you be needing...
The guard gives you a map

options.text: Do you have any other riddles for me?

steps.player: Do you have any other riddles for me?

steps.npc: Yes, what looks good on a plate with salad?
You! Now go, and bother me no more.)
Grr! Think you are a comedian, eh? Get lost!

options.text: I have lost the map you gave me.

steps.player: I have lost the map you gave me.

steps.text: If the player does not have a Skavid map in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: What's the point? Take this one and go away!

steps.text: The guard gives you another map.
If the player has a Skavid map in their bank:

steps.npc: You imps always store things in places and forget. Go look for it.

steps.text: If the player has a Skavid map in their inventory:

steps.npc: Are you blind? What is that you are carrying?
